title: Transaction relationship chain
brief: Traverse the full transaction relationship chain.
instructions: Return every item on a paid UTC 2024 order, with its order and category identity, category name, and transaction quantity times price.
For paid reporting activity, include timestamps at or after 2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and exclude timestamps at or after 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes order_item_id,order_id,product_id,qty,unit_price from order_items without solving transaction relationship chain.

hints.text: Follow foreign-key relationships, not matching display names.
Join item to order, product, and category; compute each line at item grain.
Categories 2 and 3 both have the name Audio but are separate categories.

dataClaims.sql: SELECT count(*)::VARCHAR FROM categories WHERE c_name = 'Audio' AND category_id IN (2, 3)
dataClaims.claim: hints[2]: categories 2 and 3 share the name Audio
